versions.changelog:
- Initial release of English Learning Check-in Skill.
- Enables daily check-in for English study progress, supporting exam and curriculum types like TOEFL, IELTS, PET, and New Concept.
- Automatically generates and manages daily English motivational quotes with Chinese translations, ensuring no repetition.
- Simple commands for initialization, recording check-ins, managing study types, and keeping track of quotes used.
- Flexible path configuration for dependency on learning-checkin skill.
